issue.title: [Studio 0.1.803-beta] web_search can be called with empty arguments and returns "No query provided"

llm_context.input_title: [Studio 0.1.803-beta] web_search can be called with empty arguments and returns "No query provided"
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: In Unsloth Studio/Desktop, the built-in web_search tool can be invoked by local models with an empty argument object ({}), resulting in a 'No query provided' error that stalls or breaks agent execution turns.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The underlying tool schema defines `query` and `url` as optional properties with `required: []`. At execution time, the arguments dictionary is unpacked without verifying whether both `query` and `url` evaluate to empty/whitespace strings, allowing invalid empty calls to pass through to the execution backend.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect web_search tool execution handling
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect studio/backend/core/research_runs.py to locate where the web_search tool parses its arguments and executes the search query.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add validation for empty query and url arguments
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the web_search tool execution block in studio/backend/core/research_runs.py to check if both query and url are empty, missing, or whitespace-only before proceeding.

step_by_step_plan.title: Return a recoverable model-visible error message
step_by_step_plan.description: Ensure that when empty arguments ({}) are provided, the tool returns a clear, recoverable error message back to the model prompting it to supply a valid query or url instead of failing silently or breaking execution.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test and verify execution
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a unit or integration test simulating a model call with empty arguments ({}) to the web_search tool and assert that a proper recoverable error is returned.

structured_concepts.concept_name: Tool Argument Validation & Defensive Input Checking
structured_concepts.short_explanation: Validating input parameters received from LLM tool calls before executing backend logic.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: LLMs can occasionally output malformed, empty, or unexpected tool arguments. Proper validation prevents runtime crashes and allows returning informative error messages so the model can self-correct.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Adding an execution-time check to verify that neither `query` nor `url` are empty or whitespace-only prevents passing invalid arguments into the search backend.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Using JSON schema definitions to specify which parameters are mandatory for a tool or function call.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Enforcing schema requirements guides the LLM on what inputs must be generated for a successful tool invocation.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue stems from `required: []` allowing empty arguments; understanding tool schemas helps structure robust alternative validation or schema constraints.

common_pitfalls: Making `query` unconditionally required in the schema, which would break URL fetching mode.
Failing to handle whitespace-only strings (e.g. `'   '`) in addition to empty strings (`''`).
Raising a hard unrecoverable exception instead of returning a friendly error message that the LLM can interpret and retry.
